node.title: aligning text
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext:
Hi perlmonks, i am writing a script that goes through an xml file reporting about the names and prices. I am having problems aligning the data. This is the xml file:

Belgian Waffles $5.95 Two of our famous Belgian Waffles with plenty of real maple syrup 650 Strawberry Belgian Waffles $7.95 Light Belgian waffles covered with strawberries and whipped cream 900 Berry-Berry Belgian Waffles $8.95 Light Belgian waffles covered with an assortment of fresh berries and whipped cream 900 French Toast $4.50 Thick slices made from our homemade sourdough bread 600 Homestyle Breakfast $6.95 Two eggs, bacon or sausage, toast, and our ever-popular hash browns 950

And this is the script:

open($fh,"<","xml.xml") or die $!; while(<$fh>){ if($_ =~ /\$(.*)<\/price>/){ push @arr, $1; }elsif($_ =~ /(.*)<\/name>/){ push @ar2,$1; } } @index = sort{$ar2[$a] cmp $ar2[$b]} 0..$#ar2; @har = @ar2[@index]; @har2 = @arr[@index]; $teller = 0; foreach(@har){ print "$_ "; print $har2[$teller]; print "\n"; $teller++; }

I have tried aligning the output-data with the use of spaces and tabs, but i'm not succeeding. Tx for the help.
